tasks.title: preprocess: dose retained over the >= 1 Gy region; EXTERNAL masks leave the plan minimum
tasks.test_approach: TDD on the existing NIfTI + series.json retained tests in tests/test_preprocess.py (write_plan fixtures, DOSE_SPLIT); new cases for spec acceptance tests 1, 2, 3 (preprocess part: series.json values and the run-log low-retained count), 4 (log count) and 6. Fixtures for 3-4 give every series.json row a `dicom` object (all-or-none per file) with the mask's roi_interpreted_type.
criteria: A module constant DOSE_RETAINED_GY = 1.0 defines the dose region. For kind == 'dose' only, native_retained receives the 0/1 image `native >= DOSE_RETAINED_GY` (a SimpleITK comparison, geometry kept), so the value is a voxel fraction, not summed dose; it is computed only when crosses_final(native, final) is true, else exactly 1.0. crosses_final, process_dose and has_voxels still get the unthresholded `native` (spec decision 1).
native_retained's signature and behaviour are unchanged; its unit tests pass untouched; its docstring no longer implies it is only for summed dose.
Mask `retained` is unchanged (volume-based); beam volumes still have no `retained`; `cropped` is unchanged.

One shared predicate (importable by manifest) says whether a series.json row counts toward a plan's `retained` minimum: kind dose or mask, a non-blank `retained`, and not a mask whose `dicom.roi_interpreted_type` is exactly the string 'EXTERNAL'. preprocess_plan's returned minimum uses it.
Acceptance test 1: the negligible-tail test (~L2945) is renamed to match and asserts the dose cell == '1.0' exactly; a sub-1 Gy tail that crosses the grid still counts in `cropped`.
Acceptance test 2: a dose whose >= 1 Gy region is partly cut gets the voxel fraction of that region (the existing DOSE_SPLIT test now expects 0.5, renamed to say so).

Acceptance test 3 (preprocess part): a plan with a cut EXTERNAL mask and otherwise uncut files keeps the EXTERNAL mask's series.json retained below 1.0, and the run log does not count the plan in 'with retained < 0.9'.
Acceptance test 4 (preprocess part): a cut non-EXTERNAL mask still counts in the log's low-retained count.

Acceptance test 6: test_a_retained_of_zero_alone_does_not_refuse_when_the_output_still_holds_voxels (one dose voxel of exactly 1.0 Gy centred outside the grid) still passes unchanged with retained '0.0', pinning the inclusive >= threshold; it is not moved off 1.0 Gy.
The thresholded dose is computed inside the per-file block and released with `native` (one image at a time stays true).

Stale comments and names updated: LOW_RETAINED (L53), allow_crop (L86), the retained field (L379), preprocess_plan docstring (L757); tests/test_preprocess.py L2799 comment ('summed dose is 9 / 12') and the L2833 test name (`..._of_the_summed_dose_...`).
Full suite passes (`uv run --group dev pytest -q --tb=short`); ruff clean.

tasks.title: manifest: plan retained excludes EXTERNAL masks; README describes the new meanings
tasks.test_approach: TDD in tests/test_manifest.py with series.json fixtures carrying `dicom` on every row: acceptance tests 3 (manifest part) and 5; existing _retained tests keep passing.
criteria: manifest `_retained` parses and validates every non-blank dose/mask `retained` cell as today, so any malformed cell, EXTERNAL included, still refuses with REASON_SERIES_CSV; only then does it take the minimum over the rows the task-01 predicate accepts. The test_manifest.py ~L587 malformed-cell parametrization gains an EXTERNAL-mask case.
Acceptance test 3 (manifest part): the plan line's `retained` is 1.0 when only an EXTERNAL mask is cut.
Acceptance test 5: on a series.json whose EXTERNAL mask holds the lowest value, the manifest minimum omits it; a plan whose only values are EXTERNAL masks gets no `retained` key.
Acceptance test 4 (manifest part): a cut non-EXTERNAL mask still lowers the manifest `retained`.
Stale text updated: manifest.py module docstring (L6) and the _retained docstring; the test_manifest.py ~L577 comment.

README: the --allow-crop paragraph (~L398-404) and the trailing retained paragraph (~L763) say dose retained is the fraction of voxels >= 1 Gy kept, that a dose cut only below 1 Gy counts as cropped but has retained 1.0 (replacing 'a negligible tail counts'), and that EXTERNAL masks keep their own value but are left out of the plan-level minimum and the log count; the manifest `retained` row (~L478) says it excludes EXTERNAL masks.
